outputs.explanation: Panel A shows ex vivo photographs (bright-field and ICG fluorescence) of whole lungs; it is not a plot of averaged data.
Bar graph of mean ICG fluorescence intensity with individual data points (blue and red dots) overlaid for each mouse, alongside mean ± SD bars.
Panel includes histology/RNAscope micrographs plus spatial heatmap plots (Cd68, Spp1 expression); heatmaps do not require individual data point overlays.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots showing running enrichment scores; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.

Bar graph of log2 fold change for M2/TAM genes shows only bar heights with p-values annotated; no individual data points (e.g., per-spot or per-replicate values) are overlaid despite this being an averaged/summary measure from differential expression analysis.
Panel F shows fluorescence and IHC micrographs of tissue sections; it is not a plot of averaged data.
